concept: Sand — desert expedition and heritage overland apparel. Warm, craft-driven aesthetic matching the Sand preset's cream UI (#F3EFE7 bg, rust accent #C04417).

collections.title: Apparel
collections.description: Waxed canvas and heritage cuts built for overland travel.

collections.title: Footwear
collections.description: Boots built to soften with wear, not fall apart.

collections.title: Carry
collections.description: Canvas and leather carry for the road between towns.

products.title: Desert Shell
products.desc: Vented under the arms and across the back so heat escapes before it builds, with UPF 50 for the hours between sunrise and shade.

products.title: Canvas Utility Vest
products.desc: Eight pockets sized for a notebook, a multitool, and the small things that usually end up loose in a bag. Waxed canvas breaks in, not down.

products.title: Waxed Field Jacket
products.desc: Waxed cotton sheds a passing shower without the crinkle of synthetic shells, and the corduroy collar softens with wear instead of wearing out.

products.title: Overland Cargo Pant
products.desc: Reinforced at the knee where canvas usually gives out first, cut for movement rather than a straight-leg silhouette.

products.title: Dune Cargo Shorts
products.desc: Quick-dry canvas that doesn't hold heat like denim or sand like mesh — built for the stretch of trail where both come up.

products.title: Heritage Chambray Shirt
products.desc: Brushed chambray with a snap front that layers clean under a vest or jacket without bunching at the placket.

products.title: Expedition Henley
products.desc: Heavyweight jersey with enough substance to work as a base layer at dawn and a standalone shirt by noon.

products.title: Trail Canvas Cap
products.desc: A low-profile canvas cap with a leather strap back, built to take on the shape of whoever wears it.

products.title: Wide-Brim Expedition Hat
products.desc: A brim wide enough to shade the neck, packable enough to stuff in a duffel without losing its shape.

products.title: Desert Boot
products.desc: Suede upper on a crepe sole — soft enough for a long walk, sturdy enough to not fall apart on the way back.

products.title: Canvas Belt Bag
products.desc: Brass hardware that won't corrode, sized for a phone, a wallet, and a passport when the rest stays at the hotel.

products.title: Overland Duffel 40L
products.desc: Forty liters of waxed canvas with leather trim at every stress point, built to be thrown in a truck bed for a decade.

products.title: Canvas Rucksack 22L
products.desc: A roll-top that expands past its rated 22L when the trip runs long, in canvas that only looks better with dust on it.

products.title: Bandana Trio
products.desc: Three block-printed bandanas for dust, sweat, or a quick repair — the kind of thing you always need one more of.

products.title: Leather Field Belt
products.desc: Full-grain leather with a solid brass buckle, built to darken and soften with every year it's worn.
